text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited at all times on the west side of Twenty Sixth Street between Lake Shore Boulevard West and a point 44 meters north. The proposed amendment will deter parking at this location and reduce congestion in the area of the intersection on Twenty Sixth Street near Lake Shore Boulevard.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Twenty Sixth Street, between Lake Shore Boulevard West and a point 44 metres north.
